7. 
Reason
Relief Should
Be Granted: 
Applicant
believes the reservoirs
are tight with low
permeability
and it is desirable
to drill the lateral to the longest
length
possible
to enhance
the economics
of the well. 
These wells will not drain significantly
to north and south of
the wellbores
and drainage
to the east and west is limited primarily
to the area affected
by
the fracture
stimulation; 
therefore, 
drilling
the multiunit
horizontal
well
at the locations
requested
allows
for production
from
a greater
portion
of reservoir
and the drilling
of a
longer
lateral without
uncompensated
drainage
to the offset sections.
